high_level_description: This image appears to be a slide from a presentation, likely from the "Talks at Google" series, as indicated by the logo in the bottom right corner. The slide is titled "Quasars, the farthest objects we can see," suggesting that it is discussing quasars, which are among the most distant and energetic objects in the universe. The image itself shows a cosmic scene with a bright, glowing object at the center, emitting light in various colors, including green and yellow. This central object is surrounded by a dark, starry background, indicating that it is located in deep space.
